diseases.guidance: Boil every litre that passes a lip. Purified stores block the water route entirely.
diseases.source_note: Shared cisterns and ration lines were the old strain's best friend. It lives in what we drink, not in us.

diseases.guidance: Seal the vents and keep masks on shift hands. Air moves faster than rumor does.
diseases.source_note: Carried in from scavenged bedding and dead livestock. It jumps mouths before it jumps fences.

diseases.guidance: Sterilise every tool before it touches skin. One reused blade can seed a ward.
diseases.source_note: Spread through unsterilised surgical tools and shared field dressings. The worst cases die with clean hands nearby.

diseases.guidance: Engage air filtration and keep sealed kit on anyone who peeled mold off the walls. Spores live longer than patience.
diseases.source_note: A grey bloom that rode the dust down from the dead farms. It does not need a wound, only a breath.
